entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Hey, listen up! This is horrible![n]The Phan-Site is gone!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I try to access the URL, but it[n]says that page doesn't exist!
entries.uk: Я заходжу за адресою, а там[n]пише, що такої сторінки не існує!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: The fruit of my labor has[n]completely disappeared!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Oh! Do you think it's[n]because of Medjed!?
It has to be.
No, it's Alibaba.
Did you type the wrong URL?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Huh? Who's Alibaba? Anyway,[n]this has to be Medjed's doing!
entries.uk: Га? Хто такий Алібаба? Хай там як,[n]це точно справа рук Меджеда!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'd never do such a thing! It[n]has to be Medjed's doing!
entries.uk: Я б нізащо так не зробив![n]Це точно справа рук Меджеда!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Is this supposed to be some[n]kind of penalty for cheering[n]for the Phantom Thieves!?
entries.uk: Це що, якесь покарання[n]за підтримку[n]Фантомних Злодіїв?!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: But wait, they're totally[n]jumping the gun! There's still[n]time until the cleanse!
entries.uk: Але стривай, вони ж явно[n]поспішили! До чистки[n]ще є час!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Hold on, something came up.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: "Is this proof enough for you...?"

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: What's that supposed to mean?[n]Do you think it's a virus!?
entries.uk: Що це має означати?[n]Думаєш, це вірус?!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Oh!
What is it now?
Calm down.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Well, uh... it looks like[n]everything's back to normal.
entries.uk: Ну, е-е... схоже, все[n]знову працює як слід.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Sorry for making a fuss[n]about all this...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm going to try and look into[n]it a little more though. See you.
entries.uk: Але я спробую ще трохи[n]в цьому покопатися. Бувай.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Was that Alibaba proving what she said[n]earlier? Talk about a crazy thing to pull[n]off...
entries.uk: Це Алібаба так доводить свої[n]слова? Ну й божевільний же[n]трюк...
